item.description: This 2008 Ferrari F430 Spider was purchased new by the owner and has 62k kilometers (~39k miles) following registration history in British Columbia. item.title: 1999 Nissan Skyline GT-R V-Spec at No Reserve
item.description: This 1999 Nissan Skyline GT-R is one of 4,194 V-Spec examples produced and left the factory finished in Bayside Blue over gray cloth and suede upholstery. It is powered by a twin-turbocharged 2.6L RB26DETT inline-six linked with a six-speed manual transmission and an ATTESA E-TS PRO all-wheel-drive system featuring an active limited-slip rear differential. item.title: 2k-Mile 2006 Ford GT
item.description: This 2006 Ford GT is one of 222 finished in Centennial White for the model year, and factory options included red-finished brake calipers, painted blue stripes, and a McIntosh stereo system. Power is from a supercharged 5.4-liter V8 linked with a six-speed manual gearbox and a helical limited-slip differential, and additional equipment includes Brembo brakes, HID headlights, a front splitter, a rear diffuser, and air conditioning. item.title: 1973 Ferrari 365 GTB/4 Daytona
item.description: This 1973 Ferrari 365 GTB/4 is one of 1,284 Berlinetta coupes produced between 1968 and 1973 and was imported to the US from Europe by its current owner in 2025. Wearing a repaint in metallic blue, chassis 16613 is powered by a 4.4-liter quad-cam V12 that breathes through six Weber carburetors and is paired with a five-speed manual transaxle.
